dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a smooth, deep concave curvature (falcate) from the posterior insertion point to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a medium-sized pixel radius at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Acute slope of approximately 45 to 50 degrees relative to the longitudinal dorsal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Height-to-base ratio is approximately 0.9:1, indicating the fin is slightly wider at the base than its vertical height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple parallel linear hypopigmented scars (rake marks) are visible on the lateral flank, ventral to the anterior dorsal ridge.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced bi-tonal pigmentation with a dark dorsal cape and a distinct transition to lighter lateral coloration.
